checks.details: Installed executable consumer remains substantive: all case() and require() AST calls match c23e98e unchanged. Strict Base64 and pinned SHA256 checks occur before any CLI call. Both malformed Base64 and valid Base64 with wrong checksum independently fail closed. Actual W3 p048 L1e removes bin/ and confirms consumer failure.

No product source/recipe/patch changes since prior passing review. Original binary JPEG/DNG test inputs are replaced by text Base64 transport; decoded content is still test data, not prebuilt program code. Conan build and installed consumer remain real.

Real public pslr camera/SCSI code and INDI dispatch remain compiled, with functional interface migration, error propagation and private temporary files. Offline image consumption and no-camera discovery are tested. Physical MSC settings/exposure/transfer/reconnect and vendor ARM64 PTP are explicitly pending in README, notes, manifest and drafts. Human confirmation of complete hardware adaptation remains required.

Recipe declares Linux/OHOS armv8, obtains compiler/toolchain settings through Conan, uses published dependency targets and static INDI driver/client archives, and does not hard-code compiler environment paths. System-name zlib dependency is the published static adaptation.

Final W3 L0i confirms all six actual direct dependencies available; L0j records first publication and L0k validates software-level type=tool commands.json. Official pinned HTTPS codeload source and real SHA256 retained. Missing Ricoh SDK is not an AArch64 build dependency because original upstream excludes that backend.

Pinned original indi-pentax subtree has no automated test suite, test registration or check target. Supplementary native ctest --show-only confirms Total Tests: 0. Upstream discovered/executed/passed are 0 and ratio N/A, separate from 10 added CLI cases.

All 24 current file hashes and text contents match audit input; files use LF. Embedded rules and prior rule hashes match current repository. New W3 log SHA256 verified independently. Old .ci-result.json is historical state and has not been rewritten or used as the identity of p048. Removed binary fixtures match restored bytes from c23e98e Git objects exactly.

Current changes are confined to archives/i/indi-pentax/1.0 test fixture representation, restoration helper, MANIFEST, test-report and this independent audit. No product source, dependency recipe, compiler setting or CI framework change. HEAD c23e98e364aa35a50929edf2228dd4e7f65f599f is the existing PR commit; fix is still uncommitted at audit time.

JPEG decodes to a volatile-owned temporary allocation, frees it on longjmp, and replaces caller memory only after successful completion. Native supplementary test verifies unchanged old pointer/size/bytes on corrupt scan, then successful grayscale replacement with NAxis=2. Capture filename is a full std::string, eliminating the introduced 255-byte truncation.

New actual run_local_ci p048 executed setup.sh and build_and_test.sh with exit 0, JC/L0/L1/L5 pass, installed consumer 10/10 and L1e destructive negative validation. L2 reports skip because standalone driver and image version/help probes returned nonzero; cause for the image tool probe is unresolved despite its supported --version command. These probes are not counted as passing. L4 remains nonblocking warning. Earlier p047 started before complete diff transfer and failed JC; it is not counted as a successful run.

Raw llvm-readelf output for both shipped executables shows AArch64, DYN plus PIE flag, non-executable GNU_STACK, GNU_RELRO and BIND_NOW; DT_NEEDED uses library names rather than private Conan cache paths.

The original full finish was partial and returned 1; historical ConanVerifier internal skips remain disclosed. New p048 independently proves actual local CI completion, not completion of every finish stage or remote PR CI. Latest L2 standalone probes skipped after nonzero exits; successful 10-case installed CLI execution occurred in conanrun.

Updated MANIFEST and test-report accurately describe text fixture transport and byte identity. Recipe revision terminology is corrected. New W3 records L2 skip and L4 warn without attributing unsupported behavior to the image tool. A path and pending physical camera boundaries remain unchanged. PR 14473 exists; its eventual remote CI result is not claimed by this report.

Updated Python parses, all 24 submitted files use LF, and git diff --check returns 0. Base64 replacement files are included in exact-byte inventory. Existing nonblocking conandata description and L4 observations remain unchanged.
